description: Lint a coding DNA sequence for premature stops, internal RBS/polyA motifs, unwanted restriction sites, GC extremes and repeats.

avoidEnzymes.description: Enzyme names whose internal sites should be flagged as errors. Matched against the curated common-enzyme set plus the Golden Gate Type IIS enzymes (BsaI, BbsI, Esp3I/BsmBI); an unrecognized name is rejected, never skipped.

crypticOrfMinAa.description: Minimum peptide length (aa) for a hidden alternate-frame ORF to be flagged.

frameStart.description: 1-based nucleotide where the reading frame begins.

gcHigh.description: GC% above this flags a GC-rich window.

gcLow.description: GC% below this flags an AT-rich window.

homopolymerMin.description: Minimum run length to flag a homopolymer.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: construct_qc
title: Construct QC linter
